$comment: BIOLOG canonical identifier registry. Owner: Kemi (Chief Architect & Integrator). Source of truth for ADR-0001 Decision 1. Adding or changing an entry requires an amending ADR and recorded Kemi approval. Examples are SYNTHETIC.

types.description: A BIOLOG tenant. The tenant boundary itself; never a tenant-plane record.
The permanent PERSON aggregate. Profiles attach to it; it is never replaced by a profile id.
A logical credential. A physical card issue is a child record of a credential, not this identifier.
A reader, terminal, enrolment station, production station or mobile installation.
One Document Verify session and the evidence captured within it.
A domain event. Immutable fact; carries schema_version, never an aggregate version.

business_identifiers.$comment: ADR-0001 Decision 1.6. These are attributes, never primary or foreign keys.
